title: Published report verification
responsibility: Checks every listed deployment file against the staged bytes and MIME type.

inputs.name: reportPublicationVerify.bundle
inputs.description: Bundle listing expected file paths, SHA-256 values and MIME types.

inputs.name: reportPublicationVerify.url
inputs.description: HTTPS deployment URL with a deployment subdomain and project subdomain beneath pages.dev, optionally ending in a slash.

inputs.name: reportPublicationVerify.request
inputs.type: (input: string | URL | Request, init?: RequestInit) => Promise<Response>
inputs.description: Optional request function, defaulting to fetch.

outputs.name: reportPublicationVerify
outputs.description: Promise completing without a value only after all listed files return successful responses, matching hashes and Content-Type prefixes. index.html is requested at the site root; each request receives a 30-second abort signal.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects an invalid deployment URL, unavailable file, digest mismatch or MIME mismatch. Request, timeout and byte-reading failures propagate.
